name: MonarchFunnelChart
title: FunnelChart
wrapsNative: Swift Charts BarMark(xStart:xEnd:y:) for each stage's bar, inside MonarchChartFrame; Button for selectable stages
summary: A conversion funnel: how many reach each step, the share that continues to the next step and how many drop off.
whenToUse: To show a fixed sequence of steps that people pass through, such as sign-up or hiring, where the drop between steps matters.
whenNotToUse: For values that are not steps of one flow, use MonarchBarList. For change over time, use a line or bar chart in MonarchChartFrame.
api: MonarchFunnelChart.init(_ title: String, stages: [MonarchFunnelChartStage], description: String? = nil, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = .ready, alignment: MonarchFunnelChartAlignment = .center, showsSteps: Bool = true, summary: String? = nil, emptyMessage: String? = nil, footer: String? = nil, labels: MonarchFunnelChartLabels = MonarchFunnelChartLabels(), formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = nil, formatRate: ((Double) -> String)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchFunnelChartStage) -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchFunnelChartStage.init(_ label: String, value: Double, key: String? = nil, color: MonarchChartColor? = nil)

MonarchFunnelChartLabels.init(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), stage: String? = nil, value: String? = nil, fromPrevious: String? = nil, ofFirst: String? = nil, step: String? = nil, oneStage: String? = nil, stages: String? = nil, overall: String? = nil, largestDrop: String? = nil, describeFirst: String? = nil, describe: String? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the chart, shown as the frame's heading.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title, such as the period.

options.name: status
options.description: ready, loading, empty or error. A ready chart without stages shows the empty state.

options.name: alignment
options.description: Centred bars read as a funnel; leading bars are easier to compare.

options.name: showsSteps
options.description: Shows the line between stages with the share that continued and the number dropped.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated summary that VoiceOver reads for the chart.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart, such as the source.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the frame's. Sentences with values are formats with %1$@ placeholders.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a count. The default is a number in the environment's locale.

options.name: formatRate
options.description: Writes a share from 0 to 1. The default is a percentage with at most one decimal.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Makes every stage a button, for example to list the people who dropped.

states.name: ready
states.description: One row per stage: the step line, the label with its value and share of the first stage, and the bar.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A selectable stage has the muted background while pressed.

states.name: table
states.description: View as table replaces the bars with the counts, the share of the previous stage and the share of the first.

states.name: empty
states.description: The frame's empty state, also when the chart is ready but has no stages.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's placeholder at the chart's height.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error message, with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: Bars use the first data colour (or the stage's colour slot) on the card surface. Labels and values are default text, the share and step line muted text and the step arrow subtle text, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web FunnelChart highlights a stage on hover and keyboard focus and announces it in a live region; on iOS there is no hover, every stage is its own VoiceOver element instead, and a selectable stage is a button with a pressed state. The web controlled activeIndex is not offered. Web align start is alignment .leading here. Number formats are closures instead of Intl options. The table toggle and its state are inside the component. Android uses the same names. Several closures are optional (formatValue, formatRate, onRetry, onSelect). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is formatValue.
accessibility: The stages are an accessibility container labelled with the generated summary: the number of stages, the overall conversion and the largest drop, or the summary given.
The container carries an AXChartDescriptor with one point per stage and the formatted counts as point labels, for Audio Graphs.
Each stage is one element read as its label and value, then the share of the previous and of the first stage.
With onSelect each stage is a button at least 44 points high.
Bars and step arrows are hidden from VoiceOver; every number they show is also text.
The frame title is a heading, and View as table lists every count and share.
Labels and values scale with Dynamic Type; the label and value stack when they do not fit on one line, and bar height scales too.
edgeCases: Negative and non-finite values count as zero.
A stage after a stage of zero continues at 0%, without dividing by zero.
A stage larger than the one before shows a share above 100% and is not counted as a drop.
A value above zero but tiny next to the widest stage still draws a sliver of bar.
Stage keys default to the label, so give a key when two stages share a label.
The kept height is 76 points per stage with step lines and 56 without, never under 120; text at large sizes makes it taller.

examples.title: Sign-up funnel
examples.template:
MonarchFunnelChart(
    {{title}},
    stages: [
        MonarchFunnelChartStage({{stages.0.label}}, value: {{stages.0.value|double}}, key: {{stages.0.key}}),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage({{stages.1.label}}, value: {{stages.1.value|double}}, key: {{stages.1.key}}),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage({{stages.2.label}}, value: {{stages.2.value|double}}, key: {{stages.2.key}}),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage({{stages.3.label}}, value: {{stages.3.value|double}}, key: {{stages.3.key}}),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage({{stages.4.label}}, value: {{stages.4.value|double}}, key: {{stages.4.key}}),
    ],
    description: {{description}}
)
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: {{locale}}))
examples.code:
MonarchFunnelChart(
    "Sign-up conversion",
    stages: [
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Visited pricing", value: 12_480.0, key: "visit"),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Started sign-up", value: 3920.0, key: "start"),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Verified email", value: 3105.0, key: "verify"),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Started trial", value: 1870.0, key: "trial"),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Became customer", value: 412.0, key: "paid"),
    ],
    description: "Last 30 days"
)
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: "en-US"))

examples.title: Aligned to the leading edge, selectable, without step lines
examples.code:
MonarchFunnelChart(
    "Hiring pipeline",
    stages: [
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Applied", value: 120),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Interviewed", value: 30),
        MonarchFunnelChartStage("Hired", value: 4),
    ],
    alignment: .leading,
    showsSteps: false,
    onSelect: { selected = $0.label }
)
